sera.definition: n an amber, watery fluid, rich in proteins, that separates out when blood coagulates
sera.translation:
浆液, 血清
[医] 血清; 浆液

serafina.translation: n. (Serafina)人名；(意、葡、罗、塞)塞拉菲娜 (女名), 塞拉菲纳

seraglio.definition: n living quarters reserved for wives and concubines and female relatives in a Muslim household

seraglios.definition:
plural of seraglio
n living quarters reserved for wives and concubines and female relatives in a Muslim household

serai.definition:
n. A palace; a seraglio; also, in the East, a place for the
   accommodation of travelers; a caravansary, or rest house.

serail.definition: n living quarters reserved for wives and concubines and female relatives in a Muslim household
serail.translation: n. 土耳其、苏丹的宫殿(伊斯兰教徒妻妾的)闺房

serais.translation: n. 客店，客栈( serai的名词复数 )

serajevo.translation: 萨拉热窝[南斯拉夫中部城市]

seram.translation: 斯兰岛[印度尼西亚东部](在哈马黑拉岛之南)

serang.definition: n. The boatswain of a Lascar or East Ondian crew.

serape.definition: n. a long brightly colored shawl; worn mainly by Mexican men

serapes.translation: 一种华丽的毛织布( serape的名词复数 )

seraph.definition: n. an angel of the first order; usually portrayed as the winged head of a child

seraphic.definition: a. of or relating to an angel of the first order
seraphic.translation: a. 六翼天使的, 天使一般的, 纯洁的

seraphical.translation:
adj. 天使般的；纯洁的
[网络] 如天使般的；美丽的；天使一般的

seraphim.definition: n an angel of the first order; usually portrayed as the winged head of a child

seraphine.definition:
n. A wind instrument whose sounding parts are reeds,
   consisting of a thin tongue of brass playing freely through a slot in a
   plate. It has a case, like a piano, and is played by means of a similar
   keybord, the bellows being worked by the foot. The melodeon is a
   portable variety of this instrument.

seraphs.translation: n. 六翼天使( seraph的名词复数 )

serapis.definition:
n. An Egyptian deity, at first a symbol of the Nile, and so
   of fertility; later, one of the divinities of the lower world. His
   worship was introduced into Greece and Rome.
serapis.translation: n. 塞拉皮斯(古埃及地下之神,其崇拜者曾遍及希腊、 罗马)

seraskier.definition:
n. A general or commander of land forces in the Turkish
   empire; especially, the commander-in-chief of minister of war.
seraskier.translation: n. [史](土耳其的)将军(或总司令、陆军大臣)

serax.definition: n a tranquilizing drug (trade name Serax) used to treat anxiety and insomnia and alcohol withdrawal
serax.translation: n. <加拿大><美>[药]舒宁(oxazepam的商标名)
